source_metadata.title: Drug-specific hypophosphatemia and hypersensitivity reactions following different intravenous iron infusions

atoms.canonical_statement: The study aimed to describe hypophosphataemia and hypersensitivity reactions after ferric carboxymaltose or isomaltoside 1000 administration.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This study aimed to describe the occurrence of HP and HSRs following the administration of either FCM or ISM.

atoms.canonical_statement: This was a single-centre retrospective analysis of a stable, unselected outpatient gastroenterology cohort.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: This study was a single-centre, retrospective analysis performed with a stable, unselected patient cohort in an outpatient gastroenterology setting.

atoms.canonical_statement: All patients receiving intravenous iron at Aarhus University Hospital gastroenterology/hepatology between November 2011 and April 2014 were included.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: All patients who received IV iron infusion ... between November 2011 and April 2014 were identified ... and included in this study.

population.label: All IV-iron-treated outpatients at the department, Nov 2011-Apr 2014
inclusion_criteria: Received IV iron infusion at the department between November 2011 and April 2014

atoms.canonical_statement: Infusions were identified through electronic reimbursement coding, and clinical data were abstracted from electronic medical records.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: all infusions could be identified through this registry. Data were collected from the patients’ electronic medical records

atoms.canonical_statement: Iron treatments spanning several infusions over 2-3 weeks were analyzed as an infusion-series; for patients with more than two series, only the first two were used.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: iron infusions are regarded as an ‘infusion-series.’ ... data from the first two series were used in the analysis.

atoms.canonical_statement: Phosphate measurements were grouped into baseline (day -7 to 0), week 2 (day 4-21), week 5 (day 22-49), and week 10 (day 50-90), using the lowest value within each period.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The blood sample results were categorised into four time points: baseline ... week 2 ... week 5 ... and week 10

atoms.canonical_statement: Hypophosphataemia was defined as plasma phosphate <2.0 mg/dL and severe hypophosphataemia as <1.0 mg/dL.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: HP was defined as a phosphate concentration < 2.0 mg dl−1 and severe HP as a phosphate concentration < 1.0 mg dl−1.

outcome.definition: plasma phosphate <2.0 mg/dL; severe if <1.0 mg/dL

atoms.canonical_statement: Hypersensitivity reactions were classified using the Ring and Messmer scale: grade I skin/mild fever, grade II measurable non-life-threatening symptoms, grade III shock, grade IV cardiac and/or respiratory arrest.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The Ring and Messmer Severity Scale ... was used to classify the HSRs to IV iron infusions.

atoms.canonical_statement: Analyses used t tests, chi-square tests, Fisher exact tests, Spearman correlations, and crude logistic-regression prevalence odds ratios with 95% confidence intervals; tests were two-sided at 5%.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Logistic regression analysis was applied to compute the crude prevalence odds ratios ... with associated 95% CIs.

atoms.canonical_statement: According to Danish law, Danish Ethical Committee approval was not required.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: According to Danish law, approval from the Danish Ethical Committee was not needed.

atoms.canonical_statement: The cohort comprised 231 patients receiving 308 IV iron infusion series: 192 FCM series and 116 ISM series.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: a total of 308 IV iron infusion series were administered to 231 patients. ... 192 (62%) were FCM and 116 (38%) were ISM.

atoms.canonical_statement: Of 231 patients, 125 received FCM only, 67 received ISM only, and 39 received both drugs.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 125 patients received FCM only, 67 patients received ISM only, and 39 patients received both types of iron drugs.

atoms.canonical_statement: The median IV iron dose was 1000 mg (range 500-2500 mg), with no reported dose difference between FCM and ISM.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The median dose administered was 1000 mg (range, 500–2500), with no difference between the two drugs.

atoms.canonical_statement: Most patients had inflammatory bowel disease: 101 Crohn disease and 43 ulcerative colitis (144/231; 62%).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Crohn’s disease, n (%) 101 (43.7) ... Ulcerative colitis, n (%) 43 (18.6)

atoms.canonical_statement: Median age was 41 years (range 18-87); 74/231 (32.0%) were male.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Age, years, median (range) 41 (18–87) ... Sex, male, n (%) 74 (32.0)

atoms.canonical_statement: Baseline and follow-up phosphate measurements were available for 223 of 308 infusion series (72%).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: baseline and follow-up measurements of plasma phosphate were available in 223 (72%).

population.label: Infusion series with baseline and follow-up phosphate data

atoms.canonical_statement: At week 2, hypophosphataemia (<2 mg/dL) occurred in 64/84 FCM series and 9/33 ISM series; the reported FCM prevalence odds ratio was 6.7 (95% CI 3.1-14.6); P < 0.01.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Phosphate < 2 mg dl−1 ... FCM/ISM ... 64/9 ... FCM, POR (95% CI) 6.7 (3.1–14.6)

atoms.canonical_statement: At week 5, hypophosphataemia (<2 mg/dL) occurred in 37/114 FCM series and 6/59 ISM series; the reported FCM prevalence odds ratio was 4.5 (95% CI 1.8-11.2); P < 0.01.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Phosphate < 2 mg dl−1 ... FCM/ISM ... 37/6 ... FCM, POR (95% CI) 4.5 (1.8–11.2)

atoms.canonical_statement: At week 10, hypophosphataemia (<2 mg/dL) occurred in 6/106 FCM series and 1/59 ISM series; the reported FCM prevalence odds ratio was 3.6 (95% CI 0.4-30.4).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Phosphate < 2 mg dl−1 ... FCM/ISM ... 6/1 ... FCM, POR (95% CI) 3.6 (0.4–30.4)

atoms.canonical_statement: At week 2, severe hypophosphataemia (<1 mg/dL) occurred in 13/84 FCM series and 0/33 ISM series.

atoms.canonical_statement: At week 2, a >25% phosphate decrease from baseline occurred in 70/84 FCM series and 11/33 ISM series. The reported FCM prevalence odds ratio was 10.0 (95% CI 4.0-25.2); P < 0.01.

atoms.canonical_statement: Haemoglobin increased similarly after FCM and ISM in Figure 1A.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the increase in haemoglobin levels following iron infusion was similar with the two drugs analysed.

atoms.canonical_statement: Figure 1B showed lower phosphate after FCM than ISM at weeks 2 and 5, with P < 0.01 at both plotted comparisons.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: significantly more pronounced drop in plasma phosphate ... following FCM compared with ISM

atoms.canonical_statement: Figure 1C showed a larger week-2 ferritin rise with FCM than ISM (P < 0.01).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the increase in ferritin was more pronounced with FCM than with ISM

atoms.canonical_statement: Across both drug groups, the change in ferritin from baseline to week 2 was inversely correlated with the change in phosphate (Spearman rho -0.36; P < 0.01).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Spearman's rho = -0.36, P < 0.01

population.label: Observations with paired baseline-to-week-2 ferritin and phosphate changes

concept.text: correlation of ferritin change with phosphate change from baseline to week 2

atoms.canonical_statement: Among 32 patients who received both drugs, plasma phosphate was lower after FCM than ISM at week 2 (P < 0.01).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: 32 patients who received both drugs ... P < 0.01

population.label: Patients receiving both FCM and ISM with follow-up data

atoms.canonical_statement: Among 32 patients who received both drugs, the phosphate difference favoring ISM remained at week 5 (P < 0.01).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: this difference was sustained at week 5

population.label: Patients receiving both FCM and ISM with follow-up data

atoms.canonical_statement: Among 32 patients receiving both drugs, the initial ferritin rise was larger after FCM but was not statistically significant (P = 0.09).

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: Although not statistically significant, the initial rise in plasma ferritin was more pronounced with FCM than with ISM

population.label: Patients receiving both FCM and ISM with follow-up data

atoms.canonical_statement: An HSR was documented in 14 of 231 IV-iron-treated patients (6.1%).

atoms.canonical_statement: Phosphate was not measured at all predetermined times in 28% of patients; symptom-associated follow-up could therefore overestimate the IV-iron/HP association.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: In 28% of patients, phosphate values had not been measured at all predetermined times.

atoms.canonical_statement: The cohort had a high proportion of IBD patients, creating potential susceptibility to hypophosphataemia from other causes.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: the high percentage of patients with IBD would tend to include more patients ... prone to HP from other causes.

atoms.canonical_statement: The study was single-centre, which may limit patient-selection generalizability even though it could improve data consistency.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The study was conducted at a single centre, which may have biased our results in terms of patient selection.

atoms.canonical_statement: Hypophosphataemia was analyzed infusion-wise whereas hypersensitivity reactions were analyzed patient-wise, so the two safety outcomes use different analytic units.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: We analysed data on HP infusion wise and data on HSR patient wise.

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors concluded that FCM carried a higher risk of hypophosphataemia than ISM, whereas ISM carried a higher risk of mild hypersensitivity reactions than FCM.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: higher risk of HP when giving FCM ... higher risk of mild HSRs when giving ISM

atoms.canonical_statement: The authors stated that HSR frequency in this cohort was much higher than that reported in the EMA-CHMP report.

source_anchor.verbatim_excerpt: The overall risk of HSRs was much higher than the risk presented in the EMA-CHMP report.
